properties.notes: Part of the site is currently used as car showroom and garage, with the rest vacant land. Proposals have been lodged for redevelopment in the past. Planning permission has now been granted for a development of 9 dwellings on the western, vacant parcel of land (17/02409/FUL). Whilst development has not yet commenced, completion is expected within the next 5 years. Prior to this, the eastern section of the site has been developed for a supermarket and another small retail unit (13/02550/FUL).
properties.site-address: Land west of former Willis Garage, South Road, Alnwick
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
